newsitem.title: USA: American Electric Power in Chinese joint venture.
newsitem.headline: American Electric Power in Chinese joint venture.

text.p: American Electric Power Co. Inc. said Sunday its AEP Pushan Power Ltd. unit and two Chinese companies, Henan Electric Power Development Co. and Nanyang Municipal Financial Development Co., have formed a joint venture company to finance and build an electric generating facility in China.
AEP Pushan Power will hold a 70 percent interest in the joint venture company, Nanyang General Light Electric Co Ltd., and Henan Electric and Nanyang City will each hold a 15 percent interest.
Nanyang General Light will build and operate the electric generating facility, which will have two 125-megawatt coal-fired units.
The company said the approximate cost of the facility is $172 million.
Henan Electric Power Development Co. is a unit of Henan Electric Power Co., while Nanyang Municipal Financial Development Co is affiliated with Nanyang City, China.
